intro: Ingredients for the Forge is a local task in Thelsamar where the dwarven craftsman Morhan Coppertongue requests bronze bars to replenish his depleted workshop supplies. Lacking the easy access to trade enjoyed by Ironforge, the rural settlement relies on travelers to keep its forge supplied with essential metals for tools and everyday wares.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Thelsamar's a great place to live, but we don't have all of the amenities of Ironforge. I'm always running out of bronze! I need more bronze if I'm going to keep making tools and kettles and pots!
I can tell you have a little experience at the forge. Think you could smelt me some bronze bars? I can pay you well for it!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, this is a relief! I should be able to keep the forge going now. Hopefully one of these days we'll get a trader bringing coal into town regularly!
